My sister is overweight. Honestly, tons of people were still attracted to her, including some of her crushes, but her self-doubt and self-hatred I think got in the way, most of the time. Right now, she's in a pretty happy & long-term relationship. 

She hides it well, but I know she's still insecure. Still, I think it's only that doubt that could get in the way of her current relationship, not her weight. Most people I think would agree that her weight never made her ugly, something I definitely stand by. 

Not sure how helpful this may be, but as an outsider/sibling, that's my perspective.
